crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
“Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…
who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope…
Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,
Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.
Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which…
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I…
the Jews established and imposed on themselves, and on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to…
and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every…
When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory…
Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be…
One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my…
so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”
